responsibility: This module provides GCC’s VxWorks target configuration headers that adapt the compiler’s view of the operating system’s C and C++ runtime environment, especially its standard library headers and predefined platform macros. Its main role is header interposition: the recurring wrapper family for standard headers such as complex.h, inttypes.h, math.h, setjmp.h, and stdint.h ensures GCC can include VxWorks system headers in a way compatible with VxWorks version differences and the Dinkumware-based library setup used on newer releases. Supporting headers such as _vxworks-versions.h, _yvals.h, and _yvals-wrapper.h centralize OS version detection, yvals policy setup, and C-versus-C++ inclusion mode adjustments so the front end sees consistent library feature macros and declarations. The module also contributes VxWorks-specific predefined conformance macros through vxworks-predef.h, making it the GCC configuration layer responsible for harmonizing preprocessing, standard header semantics, and target library capabilities for VxWorks builds.
